summary: Iteration 8: Verified 6 fixes for ParlourPilot (tax_percentage per-service, discount_pct per-member override, member auto-detect reset, logo on dashboard, phone/email validation). 14/14 backend pytest passed (100%). Frontend smoke: login+signup email/phone validation, dashboard renders with logo, services modal has 'Tax %' field, members modal has 'Discount % Override' with placeholder 'e.g. 20 for Student, 15 for VIP' and hint 'leave blank to use salon default 10%'. All target behaviors confirmed on live public URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1700 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, services, bills, members, reports, platform) for maintainability. Not blocking.
Deprecation warning in web console: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — RN Web deprecation, non-blocking but should be migrated in shared theme/shadows utility (src/theme).

apply_member_discount: member override discount is applied whether member is active or not — control comes from create_bill/update_bill which only looks up active:true members. Behavior is correct as long as inactive members are filtered before call; documented but a defense-in-depth check inside apply_member_discount could be added.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 smoke checks — login email val, signup email/phone val, dashboard logo render, services Tax% field, members Discount % Override field)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: test services/members/bills/beauticians/tenants created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up after each test class. One second tenant (iso_*@testsalon.com) created for isolation smoke — left in DB but flagged with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 reported fixes verified. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_tax_member_discount.py covers: service tax_percentage CRUD, member discount_pct CRUD, /members/lookup effective_discount_pct (override + tenant default), bill member override, per-line tax computation (1000 → net 800 → tax 144 → grand 944), split payment validation against services_net+tax_amount, non-member with is_member=true uses tenant default, bill UPDATE recomputes correctly, cross-tenant isolation for services. Frontend validation flows use testIDs: login-email-input, login-error, signup-email-input, signup-phone-input, signup-error, signup-submit-btn.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all fixes work as designed. Backend correctly persists tax_percentage on services and discount_pct on members, resolves member override at bill creation via active phone match, computes per-line tax on line_net, and validates split payments against services_net+tax_amount. Frontend correctly gates form submission on email regex and phone digit-count.
